title: Assets
subtitle: Equipment and installations at your stations, with their documents, warranties, inspections and maintenance.

list.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, serial number, manufacturer or model
list.emptyDescription: Assets you add will appear here.
list.noMatchDescription: Try a different search or another station.

form.createSubtitle: Register a new asset at one of your stations.
form.stationLocked: The station cannot be changed after the asset is created.
form.maintenanceHint: Internal: maintained by your own team. External: maintained by a service provider.
form.serialHint: Must be unique within your company.
form.noChanges: There are no changes to save.
form.noStations: You have no stations available, so no asset can be created.

validation.tooManyDecimals: Use at most two decimal places.

validation.branchNotAllowed: Choose one of your own stations.

validation.providerNotEligible: This provider is no longer available. Choose another one.

errors.conflictSerial: An asset with this serial number already exists in your company.
errors.validation: Some values were rejected by the server. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.unsafeUrl: This link is not accepted. Use a link that starts with http:// or https://.
errors.branchDenied: You do not have access to this station.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.unavailable: Permissions cannot be verified right now. Nothing was changed — try again shortly.

errors.warrantyRange: The end date cannot be before the start date.

toasts.documentAlreadyUploaded: This file was already uploaded — nothing was duplicated.

details.notFoundDescription: It may not exist, or it may belong to a station you cannot access.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Manuals, certificates and other files related to this asset.
documents.deleteDescription: The link will be removed from this asset. The file itself is not affected.
documents.help: Upload a PDF or an image (up to 15 MB), or add a link to a file that is stored elsewhere.

upload.hint: PDF, JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP, up to 15 MB. On a phone you can also take a photo.
upload.cancelled: The upload was cancelled. It may already have reached the server — retrying is safe and will not create a duplicate.
upload.retryHint: Retrying sends the same upload again; if it was already stored you will get that document back, not a second copy.

fileChecks.tooLarge: This file is larger than {{max}} MB.
fileChecks.typeInvalid: This type of file is not accepted. Choose a PDF, JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP file (photos in HEIC format must be converted to JPEG first).
fileChecks.unsafeName: This file name is not accepted. Rename the file and try again.

item.pdfDownloadOnly: PDF files can only be downloaded until they have been scanned.
item.blocked: This file is blocked and cannot be opened or downloaded.

documents.deleteUploadDescription: The uploaded file will be permanently removed from this asset.

fileErrors.fileTooLarge: This file is larger than 15 MB.
fileErrors.fileTypeInvalid: This type of file is not accepted. Use a PDF, JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP file.
fileErrors.signatureUnsupported: The content of this file does not match an accepted type, so it was not stored.
fileErrors.signatureMismatch: The file's content does not match its type, so it was not stored.
fileErrors.unsafeName: This file name is not accepted. Rename the file and try again.
fileErrors.limitReached: This asset already has the maximum of 50 uploaded documents. Delete one first.
fileErrors.idempotencyReused: This upload reference was already used for a different file. Choose the file again and retry.
fileErrors.malware: The file was rejected by the malware scan and was not stored.
fileErrors.scanUnavailable: The file could not be scanned right now, so nothing was stored. Try again later.
fileErrors.quarantined: This file is blocked and cannot be opened or downloaded.
fileErrors.storageUnavailable: Document storage is temporarily unavailable. Nothing was stored — try again later or contact the administrator.
fileErrors.fileMissing: The stored file could not be found. Contact the administrator.
fileErrors.noStoredFile: This document is a link and has no stored file.
fileErrors.schemaNotReady: This feature is temporarily unavailable while the system finishes an update. Try again shortly.
fileErrors.unavailable: Permissions cannot be verified right now. Nothing was changed — try again shortly.
fileErrors.branchDenied: You do not have access to this station.
fileErrors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
fileErrors.notFound: This document or asset was not found.
fileErrors.network: Connection lost. The upload may have completed — retrying is safe and will not create a duplicate.
fileErrors.server: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.

warranties.providersUnavailableAdd: The list of service providers could not be loaded, so a warranty cannot be added right now.

stateHint.UNAVAILABLE: This provider can no longer be shown.

maintenance.description: Maintenance performed by your own team.
